title: Research Problems in Function Theory — Problem 7.37
exact_target: Can one discard a set of area exactly pi from each weighted rational function so that a single universal logarithmic integral bound holds for every radius?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2307037 (AMR-022-7037). CC BY4.0.
